name: R15 M6 Celebratory Sword: Ceremonial Bite

system.description:
Your [Recovery] increases by +8. [Trigger: Immediately After Damage] Select one target that received damage from an [Melee Attack] with this weapon, and grant it [Pursuit:20]. This effect can be used [your "Shikigami Master" SR] times per [scene]. A spiritual sword engraved with prayers of gratitude for the Earth's blessings. It can generate a spiritual blade of the same shape using the keyword. This blade disappears immediately, but can be used for a coordinated attack when wielded by a spirit familiar.

Deep Adamant Ore [Core Material] (380G) + Great Naginata (1000G) + Slashing Charm (Intermediate) (230G) + Curse King Charm (Intermediate) (230G) + [Magic Catalyst 15] (220G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (1240G)
